safety.description: Blend of crime rate and pedestrian/cyclist crash rate (both inverted: lower = higher safety)

opportunity.description: Blend of permit rate (more development = higher opportunity) and unemployment rate (more unemployment = lower opportunity)

quality_of_life.formula: 100 - normalize(request_rate_pc + traffic_vkm_pc + chronic_disease_pc) + normalize(housing_rate_pc + trail_km_pc + transit_stops_pc + schools_pc + grocery_pc + healthcare_pc)
quality_of_life.description: Inverse of service requests + traffic volume + chronic disease burden, plus housing/trails/transit/schools/groceries/healthcare access rate per capita

affordability.formula: average(100 - normalize(median_home_value), 100 - normalize(median_gross_rent), normalize(median_household_income), 100 - normalize(poverty_rate), 100 - normalize(housing_cost_burden_rate), normalize(homeownership_rate))
affordability.description: Census ACS housing cost burden: lower home values/rent/poverty/cost-burden and higher household income/homeownership relative to other districts raise this index

normalization.description: Min-max scaling to 0-100 range within each component
